connect.title: Connections
connect.rowHint: Trakt, Letterboxd, Plex, Jellyfin, Goodreads, Steam, MyAnimeList and more
connect.intro: Bring in what you track elsewhere: public profiles need only a username; some services ask for a personal key you create on their site; media servers need their address. Everything is read from this phone and kept on it. Syncing only adds: what is missing here is added, what you watched, read or played there is marked here, nothing is removed. To send things the other way, export a file and import it on the service.
connect.web: In a browser most of these sites refuse to be read: use the phone app.
connect.exportLetterboxd: CSV of the films you watched that Letterboxd doesn’t have. Import it at letterboxd.com/import.
connect.autoHint: Connected accounts are read again when you open the app, twice a day at most.
connect.filesHint: Films and series: Letterboxd (diary, watched, ratings, watchlist .csv), IMDb (ratings or watchlist .csv), Trakt (export .json), TV Time (data export .csv), Netflix (viewing activity .csv), Serializd (diary .csv or .json). Books: Goodreads and StoryGraph exports, LibraryThing, Libib or any list with titles and authors. Games: HowLongToBeat, Grouvee, Backloggd, Playnite or any list with titles and platforms. Several at once is fine.
connect.failed: Couldn’t read it. Check the username and that the profile is public.
connect.unmatchedHint: These couldn't be matched to a show, film, book or game source. They are retried in a few days.
connect.notFound: No public profile with that username. Check the spelling, or paste the profile link.
connect.offline: Couldn’t reach the service. Check your connection and try again (Serializd can take a minute to wake up).

note.letterboxd: The feed holds your latest 50 entries: import the export zip once (below) for your whole history. Export writes a CSV for letterboxd.com/import.
note.serializd: Serializd has no import page yet, so it can only be read from. Shows from TVmaze are matched by title, or exactly with a TMDB key.
note.trakt: Create a free app on trakt.tv (any name, redirect URI urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob) and paste its Client ID. Your profile must be public. Export writes an IMDb-format CSV that Trakt imports.
note.mal: Export writes a MyAnimeList XML of the anime missing there, for myanimelist.net/import.php.
note.anilist: Export writes a MyAnimeList XML of the anime missing there: AniList imports it in Settings › Import.
note.kitsu: Your username or the name in your profile link (kitsu.app/users/…).
note.plex: The server address (http://192.168.1.10:32400 at home, or your plex.direct address) and your X-Plex-Token. Watched films and every show you started come in, with episode dates.
note.jellyfin: The server address (http://192.168.1.10:8096) and an API key from Dashboard › API Keys. Leave the user empty to read the first one.
note.emby: The server address (http://192.168.1.10:8096) and an API key from Settings › API Keys. Leave the user empty to read the first one.
note.goodreads: Paste your profile link (goodreads.com/user/show/12345-name) or just the number. Export writes a Goodreads CSV for My Books › Import and export.
note.openlibrary: Your username (openlibrary.org/people/…). Make the reading log public in Settings › Privacy.
note.bookwyrm: name@instance (e.g. mouse@bookwyrm.social) or your profile link. Export writes a Goodreads CSV that BookWyrm imports.
note.hardcover: Copy the token from hardcover.app › Settings › API. It stays on this phone. Export writes a Goodreads CSV that Hardcover imports.
note.steam: Your profile link, custom URL name or 17-digit id; the profile and game details must be public. The key (steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey) adds your library with playtime: games played over an hour are added as started.
note.retroachievements: Your username and the web API key from retroachievements.org › Settings. Games are matched by title.
